intro: Two {{pairName}} block the path ahead, moving in perfect, unsettling unison.$Each mirrors the other's every breath — as if they were once a single being…
title: The Severed Pair
description: The pair circles you as one mind in two bodies. Something about them feels incomplete — and whatever severed them left behind the means to join what was divided.

1.label: Battle the Pair
1.tooltip:
(-) Fight Two Bosses at Once
(+) DNA Splicers
1.selected: The two {{pairName}} shriek in unison and attack as one!

2.label: Leave Them Be
2.selected: You give the eerie pair a wide berth.$Their synchronized gaze follows you until you're out of sight.

outro:
Where the pair fell, a strange device glimmers —
the very thing that once split them apart.
